text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cross-trading between Kuwait, Lebanon and Egypt bourses will increase investment activities and attract new investors, Kuwait Stock Exchange official says.
- Kuwait reaffirms political and financial support for Bosnia.
- Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah tells parliament that the government is committed to ban any musical concerts which clash with Kuwaiti traditions.
- Foreign residents are expected to pay health insurance by mid-1997, an official said.
- Interior Minister Sheikh Mohammad Khaled al-Sabah reshuffles senior officers.
- Customs to conduct strict checks on imported goods, Trade Ministry official says.
